usage_rules.headings: Use Rajdhani for all headings (h1-h6). Weight: 600 or 700. Tracking: tight (-0.02em).
usage_rules.body: Use Inter for all paragraphs, inputs, and data tables. Weight: 400 (regular) or 500 (medium).
usage_rules.data: Use JetBrains Mono for tracking IDs, license plates, and coordinates.

primary.description: Safety Orange - High visibility, action-oriented. Use for CTAs and active states.

secondary.description: Deep Slate - The backbone. Use for sidebars, headers, and heavy containers.

accent.description: Tech Blue - Use for information, links, and secondary actions.

grid_system.dashboard: Bento Grid Mode B (High Density). Use grid-cols-12. Widgets should span 3, 4, or 6 columns.
grid_system.landing: Tetris Grid Mode A (Asymmetry). Use large hero sections with overlapping elements.

containers.dashboard_card: bg-card border border-border rounded-lg shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-200

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 shadow-lg shadow-primary/20 font-rajdhani font-bold uppercase tracking-wide rounded-sm
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/80 font-rajdhani font-semibold rounded-sm

cards.style: Flat, technical look. Avoid excessive rounded corners. Use rounded-sm or rounded-md.

inputs.style: bg-background border-input focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/50 rounded-sm font-inter

tables.style: Dense, high-contrast headers. Row hover effects mandatory.
tables.header: bg-muted/50 text-muted-foreground font-rajdhani uppercase text-xs tracking-wider

visual_enhancers.gradients: Use subtle gradients for active states only. Example: bg-gradient-to-r from-primary to-orange-600.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use 'Grid Borders' style for dashboards. 1px solid border-border/50.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Use colored shadows for primary actions: shadow-orange-500/20.
visual_enhancers.textures: Add a subtle noise texture to the dark mode background to reduce banding and add 'grit'.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. INSTALL FONTS: Add the Google Fonts import to index.css immediately.
2. CONFIGURE TAILWIND: Update tailwind.config.js with the provided colors and font families.
3. THEME STRATEGY: Implement a 'Hybrid' theme. Public pages = Light Mode (Trust). Dashboard = Dark Mode (Focus). Use a toggle for user preference.
4. DASHBOARD LAYOUT: Build a sidebar layout for the dashboard. The sidebar should be dark (slate-900) with orange active indicators.
5. MAP INTEGRATION: For the 'Live Tracking' page, use a placeholder map image if a real map library is not available, but style the overlay controls (zoom, search) using the 'Glass Panel' style.
6. DATA DENSITY: This is a logistics app. Do not use massive whitespace in data tables. Keep them compact (p-2 or p-3) so fleet managers can see more rows at once.
7. MOBILE RESPONSIVENESS: Ensure the 'Driver' view is mobile-first. Big buttons, clear text, easy to hit with a thumb while on the road.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯📚🎭🎬🎪🎉🎊🎁🎀🎂🍰🎈🎨🎰💰💵💳🏦💎🪙💸🤑📊📈📉💹🔢🏆🥇 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...)
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...})
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx
